notes.title: FISH HERO is 25% off and is now Available to Download on the App Store
notes.content:
I've been working hard on porting the game to mobile, as you can probably tell there are a lot of assets to optimise! Fish Hero is available for free on the App Store and is coming soon to the Google Play Store (sorry Android users). There are some new rules for getting games on the Google Play store which have made it a pain to release it for everyone. 

If you want to take part in closed testing for the Play Store version, Click this link on mobile
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fishhero.mode24 ]Mobile[/url]

or if you're on the web
[url=https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.fishhero.mode24]web[/url]

If you hate it or love it please leave reviews and tell me if you find it more or less difficult on mobile. 

It was great to see Blarg and SMii7Y play the game last week! Here are their videos here: 

[previewyoutube=s9aKqKxhlcQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=yaSMir8FA5k;full][/previewyoutube]

Good luck on mobile!

notes.content:
Fish Hero just passed 1,000 units and was picked up by streamers like Sodapoppin and Forsen during its first week. So far, only 1.1% of players have reached the summit but I'm hopeful that more of you will get to see the top.

Also there's a mobile version of Fish Hero coming for free which is already available on iOS but waiting on a review for the Google Play Store. There'll be an announcement for that shortly.

Thanks again for picking up Fish Hero!

notes.title: Multiplayer Issues
notes.content:
There are instabilities within the multiplayer lobby system that affect a small percentage of users. Our network solution has limitations for players connecting from:

Distant geographical locations relative to the hosts game/lobby
Certain combinations of NAT types

This issue impacts a small percentage of users attempting to connect over long geographical distances or users with a Strict NAT type on the host's game.

If you encounter these issues, we recommend using 

- a proxy or VPN to match your network geolocation with that of the host, 
or
- allowing another user to host the game/lobby with an Open or Moderate NAT type. 

sorry for not finding this issue sooner

notes.title: Fish Hero is trOUT
notes.content:
[h1]It's a bit difficult[/h1]

I'm grateful for all the support over the games development! 

Here's the launch trailer.

[previewyoutube=Ly91OF35QAU;full][/previewyoutube]

I also just released a devlog for the game which covers the start and end of the dev process.

[previewyoutube=Xy4B4KoIb44;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm looking forward to building the next game and hoping to take a much more strategic route especially when it comes to marketing. Everything I've done for marketing this game has been just me and it's been super difficult and demotivating to see not much progress in numbers. But anyways I'm glad you've seen the page as it means I'm doing something right. 

[h2]GOOD LUCK![/h2]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Here's the announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=ACNcnQR7-1I;full][/previewyoutube]

It's slightly annoying timing since I'm devoting the next couple weeks to the Pirate Software Jam to create something fresh. Fish Hero has been in the works for a few months, but it's time to move forward onto the next dev journey. It's our first Steam launch but we won't be stopping no matter if the game gets no sales (although it would be slightly frustrating no?)

Thanks for checking out the game anyway even if it's not your cup of tea!
Henry
